title: Minimalistic Armor
description: A clean and simple Minecraft armor pack with minimal details for a sleek and subtle look.
body:
Tired of armor hiding your minecraft skin?
This pack lets you wear full armor, but also see your skin!
All the Armor has been made to cover up less of your skin, but also show some armor!
Netherite, Diamond, Gold, Iron, Copper, Leather and Chainmail armor, + working with trims.
